message.content:
Replaced the vector copy constructors with range constructors using `begin()`/`end()`, which avoids the allocator-copy and relocation checks inside `std::vector`'s copy constructor while producing identical vectors.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values.begin(), field.values.end()),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes.begin(), field.stringIndexes.end())
{
}
```
